description: Each conversation a DM automation started, newest first, with where it stands and why: matched (nothing sent yet, for example held by the hourly cap), sent, waiting (for a tap, an email or a follow), clicked (tapped a link) or failed. Every message tried is listed with its status and taps, and totals count each state. Use it to see why someone didn't get a message. A failed run is shown to people as "DM needs attention". hold says why an unfinished conversation is held; hold handoff means they asked for a person: dm_handoff_close with its contact_id hands them back.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.
